ETF_proxy_precedent.adopted: Sector ETF proxies for allocation reasoning
ETF_proxy_precedent.limit: The paper uses 14 Chinese sector instruments; selection of these 11 US SPDR funds is LIBERA's public implementation, not that paper's asset list.

GICS_definition.status: official industry classification source; GICS is separate from FF12

data.limit: Yahoo's adjusted-close series is preserved without claiming issuer-certified NAV total return. Current vendor revisions/adjustments may differ from data published at the historical cutoff. Raw close and corporate-action events are retained separately.

lookback.adopted: 60 trading-day return lookback and 252-day annualization convention for risk diagnostics
lookback.implementation: 61 closes produce 60 daily returns; all 11 assets use exactly the same observed dates.
lookback.limit: Risk diagnostics only, no borrowed profile caps, objective coefficients, confidence levels or claimed future optimality.
lookback.locator: Appendix B market context/B.2 covariance and C.1

sector_unit.not_adopted: Paper-specific stock universe, agent models, long/short strategy or reported performance.
